channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Nampally MLA Majid Hussain Opens Free Parking Facility Near Niloufer Hospital to Ease Traffic Congestion
item.description: Nampally MLA Majid Hussain inaugurates free two-wheeler parking near Niloufer Children’s Hospital in Hyderabad to solve the long-pending parking issue and reduce traffic congestion.

item.title: Hyderabad Court Convicts Man in POCSO Case, Sentenced to 3 Years Jail
item.description: Hyderabad court convicts' man in POCSO case registered at Shahinayathgunj Police Station and sentences him to three years of rigorous imprisonment with a fine.

item.title: Mohammed Azharuddin Distributes Ramzan Gifts at Bagh-e-Aam Shahi Masjid in Hyderabad
item.description: Telangana Minorities Welfare Minister Mohammed Azharuddin distributes Ramzan gifts at Bagh-e-Aam Shahi Masjid in Hyderabad under the Congress Government’s Ramzan welfare initiative.

item.title: Ponnam Prabhakar Urges SHG Women to Use Govt Schemes for Empowerment
item.description: Minister Ponnam Prabhakar launches Praja Palana–Pragathi Pranalika programme in Hyderabad and urges SHG women to utilise Telangana government welfare schemes for empowerment.

item.title: Kishan Reddy Urges CM Revanth Reddy to Resolve Land Acquisition Delay for Amberpet Service Road on NH-163
item.description: Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy urges CM Revanth Reddy to resolve land acquisition delays and complete the Amberpet service road at NH-163 in Hyderabad to ease traffic congestion.

item.title: Bike Catches Fire Near Asif Nagar Police Station in Hyderabad, Major Mishap Averted (Video Viral)
item.description: Local residents immediately alerted the police and fire authorities. Officials rushed to the spot and managed to bring the fire under control promptly, preventing the situation from turning into a major accident.

item.title: Hyderabad to Tirupati TGSRTC Bus Accident Near Moosapet in Mahabubnagar: 3 Dead, 11 Injured in Divider Jump Crash
item.description: Reports about a TGSRTC bus accident near Moosapet in Mahabubnagar claiming three deaths and several injuries remain unconfirmed as of March 7, 2026.

item.title: Middle East tensions: LPG price up by Rs 60, commercial cylinders dearer by Rs 114.5
item.description: State-owned oil marketing companies (OMCs) on Saturday raised the prices of domestic and commercial LPG cylinders, with household cooking gas becoming costlier by Rs 60 and commercial cylinders by Rs 114.5, amid rising global energy prices linked to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: At least 1,332 Iranian civilians killed in US-Israeli airstrikes: Iran’s UN envoy
item.description: Over 180 children across the country have been killed and more than 20 schools have been damaged, Iravani told reporters at the UN headquarters in New York, quoting the Iranian Red Crescent Society, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Mild tremors felt in Rajasthan, 3.5 magnitude quake recorded near Sikar
item.description: According to the National Center for Seismology, the earthquake occurred at around 6.30 a.m. The epicentre was located approximately 69 km northwest of Jaipur at a shallow depth of about 5 km beneath the Earth’s surface.
